_comment: Citation for the Deadly Demise X core rule (10e). Mapper parses the integer from BSData infoLink modifier; simulator rolls 1D6 on death, applies X mortals within 6" on a 6.

simulator.deadly_demise.quoted_text: Some models have 'Deadly Demise x' listed in the abilities section of their datasheet. If a model has this ability, then when it is destroyed, roll one D6 before removing it from the battlefield: on a 6, each unit within 6" of the bearer suffers a number of mortal wounds denoted by 'x'.
simulator.deadly_demise.trigger: a model with Deadly Demise X is destroyed; before removing it from the battlefield
simulator.deadly_demise.effect: (approximation) roll 1D6; on a 6, each unit within 6" of the destroyed model suffers X mortal wounds. SwegHammer collapses the codex variants (D3, D6, D3+3, integer N) to a fixed integer expected value at mapper time (D3→2, D6→3, D3+3→5, N→N) so the runtime sees a single integer; the 1-in-6 trigger rate is preserved. Mortal wounds route through receive_damage so FNP and Death Guard's Disgustingly Resilient compose; secondary kills from a demise do NOT cascade-trigger their own demise in the same dispatch.
